items.question: Prepare a weekly summary of the garden sensor project.
items.reply: Reviewing this week's notes and measurements. The summary will include the new moisture sensor readings, the watering schedule and the remaining calibration work.

items.question: Make the reading list easier to browse on a small screen.
items.reply: The reading list now groups books by topic, keeps the current position when returning from a detail view, and uses larger controls for page navigation. The layout was checked at the target portrait size.

items.question: Add a simple export for the daily observations.
items.reply: Added a CSV export with the observation date, sensor value and notes. Column names remain consistent between exports, and missing readings are left blank instead of being reported as zero.
